_about: Editorial flags for images that show how power wanted to be seen (propaganda, official art, posed photographs). Flagging is a classification, not new history: each flag cites the knowledge-base text that justifies it. The note shown on the site is the image's own caption plus the checklist in sources/primary_sources.md ('How to read primary sources critically'). Traced in CONTENT_TRACE.md §1 (id I1).
basis: images/IMAGE_INDEX.md, 'How images were chosen': "Propaganda (the Völkischer Beobachter, Hitler Youth marches), official art (Bürde, Hünten) and posed colonial photographs show how power wanted to be seen — read them with the same source criticism as texts."
